job.title: Entry Level Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Entry-Level Manager

Pay: $50,000 - $60,000

Overview

If you’re an early-career professional who is eager to learn, you take ownership, move fast, and want to lead, this is not just another job. This is a structured, entry-level, path into management.

At Summit Careers, we don’t hire experienced managers off the street, we build them. This role is designed for individuals who want to earn leadership through performance, not tenure. You’ll start by learning the business from the ground up and progress into a leadership role in under a year.

What You’ll Do

From day one, you’ll be actively involved in the core of our business:

  • Recruit, interview, and onboard candidates
  • Manage employees throughout their lifecycle (performance, engagement, retention)
  • Partner with clients to understand hiring needs and deliver talent
  • Submit qualified candidates and manage the hiring process
  • Provide high-level customer service to both clients and employees
  • Support daily branch operations and drive results

This is a fast-paced, people-driven environment where urgency and attention to detail matter.

What We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for average. We’re looking for people who:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Take ownership and naturally step into leadership roles
  • Thrive with autonomy but stay accountable
  • Are highly detail-oriented and operate with urgency
  • Are competitive and driven, but still team-oriented
  • Build strong relationships and communicate effectively
  • Want a clear path to management and are willing to earn it

Growth Path (Performance-Based)

This is a clearly defined, accelerated path into leadership:

  • Phase 1: Recruiting & Talent Management (~5-8 Months)
  • Phase 2: Account Management (~3-6 Months)
  • Phase 3: Operations Manager (Ideally under 12 months)

Your progression is entirely performance-driven. The faster you produce results, the faster you advance.

Training & Development

We invest heavily in your success:

  • Hands-on, real-world training from experienced leaders
  • Advanced technology and AI tools to accelerate learning
  • Continuous coaching and feedback
  • Clear expectations and measurable goals

You won’t be guessing, you’ll know exactly what it takes to win.

Our Core Values

Everything we do is built around:

  • GSD (Get Stuff Done): No excuses—just results
  • Good People: High integrity, positive attitude
  • Passion for Service: We care deeply about our clients, employees, and our communities
  • Coachable: Always learning, always improving

This is a rare opportunity to fast-track your career into leadership. If you’re looking for a role where your effort directly determines your growth, you’ll fit right in!

job.title: Plastic Injection Molding Process Technician
job.description:
We have an immediate opening for 1st Shift Processing Technician:

POSITION SUMMARY

The Plastic Injection Molding Process Technician is responsible for all aspects of the molding process. The Process Technician assists and supervises all first shift operations to meet the production schedule. Essential duties include:

  • Start-up injection molding machines and equipment at start of shift; ensure jobs are running at steady-state within appropriate cycle times and meeting quality standard before turning over to Operators
  • Direct daily operations to achieve planned production schedule; assign Operators to jobs/tasks, plan daily workload, and fill-in roles to fill gaps as required
  • Relieve Operators for scheduled breaks, as needed
  • Train department employees on safety, quality, and operating procedures
  • Properly communicate and document all process changes; clearly and effectively communicate approved deviations to standard workflows
  • Perform job changeovers (teardown previous and set up next job) according to standard work procedures and changeover checklists
  • Install dies safely on machines to support production changeover schedule; perform insert changes on mold to assist the toolroom, as required
  • Set up and service all work stations within the Molding Department according to established, documented standard process parameters
  • Manage raw material inventory; prepare materials for processing by blending, mixing, and/or drying according to establish, documented standard parameters
  • Ensure all product meets quality specifications during in-process inspections according to product-specific Quality Assurance Plan (QAP)
  • Ensure all product is packaged and labeled correctly per product-specific specifications
  • Perform minor troubleshooting to keep jobs running to quality standards
  • Optimize process parameters to achieve quality parts and improve cycle times
  • Recommend and support improvement projects to continually improve processes and/or workflows
  • Monitor department operations to ensure all standard procedures are followed; safety, quality, and operational standard procedures. Take corrective action required to ensure all direct employees and daily operations meet production and quality standards
  • Purge injection molding machines and follow approved procedures to shut-down department at end of shift

Responsibilities of the 1st Shift Processing Technician:

  • Start up injection molding machines and equipment, ensure they are running at steady-state with appropriate cycle times and quality standard before turning over to operators
  • Relieve operators for breaks
  • Train employees on safety/quality/operating procedures
  • Perform job changeovers
  • Manage raw material inventory
  • Perform troubleshooting as needed

Requirements of the Processing Technician:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3-6 months of Plastic Injection experience

job.description:
Job Title: Entry-Level Manager

Pay: $50,000 - $60,000

Overview

If you’re an early-career professional who is eager to learn, you take ownership, move fast, and want to lead, this is not just another job. This is a structured, entry-level, path into management.

At Summit Careers, we don’t hire experienced managers off the street, we build them. This role is designed for individuals who want to earn leadership through performance, not tenure. You’ll start by learning the business from the ground up and progress into a leadership role in under a year.

What You’ll Do

From day one, you’ll be actively involved in the core of our business:

  • Recruit, interview, and onboard candidates
  • Manage employees throughout their lifecycle (performance, engagement, retention)
  • Partner with clients to understand hiring needs and deliver talent
  • Submit qualified candidates and manage the hiring process
  • Provide high-level customer service to both clients and employees
  • Support daily branch operations and drive results

This is a fast-paced, people-driven environment where urgency and attention to detail matter.

What We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for average. We’re looking for people who:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Take ownership and naturally step into leadership roles
  • Thrive with autonomy but stay accountable
  • Are highly detail-oriented and operate with urgency
  • Are competitive and driven, but still team-oriented
  • Build strong relationships and communicate effectively
  • Want a clear path to management and are willing to earn it

Growth Path (Performance-Based)

This is a clearly defined, accelerated path into leadership:

  • Phase 1: Recruiting & Talent Management (~5-8 Months)
  • Phase 2: Account Management (~3-6 Months)
  • Phase 3: Operations Manager (Ideally under 12 months)

Your progression is entirely performance-driven. The faster you produce results, the faster you advance.

Training & Development

We invest heavily in your success:

  • Hands-on, real-world training from experienced leaders
  • Advanced technology and AI tools to accelerate learning
  • Continuous coaching and feedback
  • Clear expectations and measurable goals

You won’t be guessing, you’ll know exactly what it takes to win.

Our Core Values

Everything we do is built around:

  • GSD (Get Stuff Done): No excuses—just results
  • Good People: High integrity, positive attitude
  • Passion for Service: We care deeply about our clients, employees, and our communities
  • Coachable: Always learning, always improving

This is a rare opportunity to fast-track your career into leadership. If you’re looking for a role where your effort directly determines your growth, you’ll fit right in!

seeking a confident, efficient person to fill this machinist role in our Lathe department.
